summary: The EIC Pathfinder Challenges 2025 fund early-stage, high-risk/high-gain research projects aimed at breakthrough deep-tech innovations up to Technology Readiness Level 4 (TRL 4). The funding targets visionary projects that could create new markets, redefine industries, or address urgent global priorities in four strategic challenge areas: biotech solutions for climate resilience and circular bio-based materials; generative AI agents for critical applications; next-generation health technologies; and deep-tech for clean energy and sustainable environments. The program offers grants up to €4 million per project with a total budget of around €120 million. It supports interdisciplinary consortia and encourages bridging scientific discovery with real-world impact.
eligible_applicants: Companies including start-ups, SMEs, and larger enterprises
Consortia of at least three independent legal entities from different EU Member States or associated countries
Single applicants and small consortia (two partners) only for Pathfinder Challenges
activity_types: Interdisciplinary research addressing grand societal challenges
Research reaching proof of principle or technological proof-of-concept (up to TRL 4)
reporting_requirements: Proposals must demonstrate a long-term vision for breakthrough innovation with market and societal impact potential
Projects should produce foundational research results enabling the envisioned technologies
Proposals are expected to consider continuation measures post-funding such as generating Intellectual Property
